g1.label: 1. We recommend ___ a second silent room
g1.why: After “recommend” use the -ing form, not “to” + verb.

g2.label: 2. We suggest that the cafeteria ___
g2.why: “Suggest that” + subject takes the base verb: “that the cafeteria offer”.

g3.label: 3. One advantage ___ that…
g3.why: The fixed frame is “One advantage is that…”.

g4.label: 4. A buddy system ___ help new students
g4.why: “Could” presents a possible result; “will definitely” and “must” claim too much.

g5.label: 5. One possible ___ is that buddies stop answering
g5.why: Buddies stopping is a problem, so it is a risk, not an advantage or benefit.

g6.label: 6. This could be improved ___ giving training
g6.why: “Improved by + -ing” names the method of improving something.

g7.label: 7. The library ___ open empty lecture rooms
g7.why: “Should” + base verb gives advice; “is open” and “has open” are ungrammatical here.

g8.label: 8. ___, a third of assignments are late
g8.why: “As a result” introduces a consequence of the sentence before it.
